newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan buys Australian wheat at about $152/tonne.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan buys Australian wheat at about $152/tonne.

text.p: Pakistan bought 225,000 tonnes of Australian wheat from Cargill at about $152 per tonne for December 11-31 shipment at its December 1 tender, an Australian diplomat confirmed on Thursday.
"It was a direct shootout between us and the United States," he said. "I guess we won by a small margin."
He said he expected Pakistan to tender again in January, but it was not clear how much it would be seeking.
Pakistan had issued two tenders side by side on November 23 inviting bids on December 1 for the supply of 225,000 tonnes of U.S. soft white wheat or Australian white milling wheat.
